_what: How well a person knows someone, worked out on every read of a list row from the records that name it (src/list-relationships.mjs), never kept and never typed: a relationship field is always derived. `sources` are the stored interactions: a record `type` that names a row under participation `role` (src/record-model.json parts: a message's `about` names a row it mentions under role `record`, an arrival names who spoke under `speaker`), when it happened (the first of `at` its value has) and the `kind` of interaction it counts as. `attributes` are what a field can show: `of` is first, last or next (the earliest interaction after now), count, or strength; `answers` is the field kind views compare it as; `kinds`, when given, counts only those interaction kinds. `strength` bands are read in order: the first whose `min` interactions all fall within `within_days` gives the label. Past `holders_read` records naming one row, or once a read has looked at `reads_per_list_read` records, a row's relationship fields answer nothing rather than a partial value.
